cuts.placeText: a bowling alley — shiny wooden lanes, ball racks, colorful lane lights and a score display
cuts.scene: she is the manager sitting sideways on a chair, polishing a bowling ball with both hands, a pro with her own style
cuts.outfit: a bowling alley staff look fitted to her body — a fitted short-sleeved bowling shirt tied at the waist and a short skirt with lane shoes, bare legs, a red-and-white pin and shiny ball-shaped earrings
